issue_request: FHIR-12590 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary issue asking ConceptMap to support default mappings for codes not otherwise listed by adding an unmapped element, sibling to element, with fixed-code, use-source-code, and other-map options.
initial_application: Jira cites svn revision 11144. The corresponding git-svn commit 7ad0c6364e2c36a9bc3d92cb70f7aa22231970c3 is titled "#12590 & #12617 - add default mappings and display to ConceptMap" and added ConceptMap.group.unmapped, the conceptmap-unmapped-mode code list, fixed/other-map constraints, and an example fixed unmapped mapping; later refactors preserved this in structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issues refined the unmapped feature without reversing it: FHIR-14686 clarified fallback descriptions, FHIR-22100 clarified mode definitions, FHIR-22129 added relationship, FHIR-32543 constrained fixed-mode code/display, FHIR-32545 renamed url to otherMap, FHIR-32546 renamed provided to use-source-code, and FHIR-34279 added valueSet support. FHIR-55356 is only triaged background.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The latest combined source defines ConceptMap.group.unmapped with use-source-code, fixed, and other-map modes; fixed mode supports code or valueSet; other-map uses otherMap; relationship captures the default relationship for fixed/use-source-code; the CodeSystem and notes describe the current modes; and the ConceptMap example demonstrates an unmapped fixed-code mapping.
